plainLanguage: San Antonio builds to the 2024 International Residential Code with city changes (since May 1, 2025), but its energy rules are still the 2021 energy code. Most new houses sit in the R-6 zone: lots of at least 6,000 sq ft, about 5 ft to each side, 20 ft at the back, and a short front setback - but your subdivision plat often sets a deeper front line, so check it. Houses can be up to 35 ft and two and a half stories. Your foundation plan needs an engineer, architect or soil report, and post-tensioned slabs always need an engineer. Trees matter: you must keep a share of large trees and plant two new shade trees. Expect SAWS water and sewer impact fees of roughly $7,000-$11,500. Lots in the north may be over the Edwards Aquifer, which limits paving.
